proposed_comments.title: Start diagnostics when ETW is the only listener
proposed_comments.body:
### Start diagnostics when ETW is the only listener

**Severity:** `medium`

When an ETW consumer enables `IconLoadEventSource` without starting the text report, `IconLoadDiagnostics.IsRecording` remains false and this request skips `BeginRequest`, so ETW-only sessions lose request and attribution events. Include the ETW provider enabled state in this gate so the same measurement is created whenever either diagnostics sink is active.

```suggestion
            diagnostics = IconLoadDiagnostics.IsRecording || IconLoadEventSource.Log.IsEnabled()
```

confidence.rationale: The current condition directly controls request measurement creation, and the fork fix is a one-line localized replacement validated on the exact pinned head.

proposed_comments.title: Reject completions from a replaced source handler
proposed_comments.body:
### Reject completions from a replaced source handler

**Severity:** `high`

The version and source-key checks do not detect a handler replacement when the same `SourceKey` is rebound. An earlier asynchronous completion can therefore assign its icon after the control has switched to a new `SourceRequested` handler. Include the handler identity in the stale-request check so only the request started by the current handler may update `Source`.

```suggestion
            if (requestVersion != iconBox._requestVersion ||
                !ReferenceEquals(sourceKey, iconBox.SourceKey) ||
                !ReferenceEquals(sourceRequested, iconBox._sourceRequested))
```

confidence.rationale: The async method captures the handler and the existing event accessor can replace it without changing SourceKey; the added identity check is the minimal validated fix.
